title: Reported Questions in the Past
goal: Report yes/no questions with si and information questions with a question word after a past verb, and use the same pattern after preguntarse and no sabía.
grammar: Reported questions and indirect question clauses in the past

items: I can report a yes/no question with si and an information question with its question word after a past verb.
I can move the verb back in a reported question (¿Cuándo saldrán? becomes quiso saber cuándo saldrían).
I can use preguntarse and no sabía with a question word.
I can use the new words for wondering and not knowing.
